summary: In this episode, we’re diving deep into Amazon Q, your generative AI–powered assistant designed for work that can be tailored to your business, recently launched at re:Invent 2023. We’ll go through Amazon Q’s main areas of expertise so you can learn about how Amazon Q can help you get fast, relevant answers to pressing questions, solve problems, generate content, and take actions using the data and expertise found in your company's information repositories, code, and enterprise systems. You'll hear from experts, such as product managers, on how Amazon Q can boost your workforce productivity with generative AI, transform the way you build, optimize, and operate applications and workloads on AWS, deliver customer service agents the responses, actions, and information they need to solve issues in real time, or and help BI users build, discover, and share actionable insights and narratives in seconds. Finally, we touch on how Amazon Q handles the security of your data, go through some responsible AI capabilities, and offer you tips and tricks to get the most out of Amazon Q.
title: #647: Amazon Q is your new generative AI–powered assistant
